newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer says Wilson golf rebuild to take time.
newsitem.headline: Amer says Wilson golf rebuild to take time.

text.p: Finnish sport goods maker Amer-yhtyma Oy said it would take time to restructure its troubled Wilson golf division.
"In the Wilson golf division, the link between the manufacturer, the retailer and the consumer has clearly weakened," Amer said in an issue of its quarterly newsletter Amerinfo, received on Thursday.
"The communication links must be rebuilt again and that will not come about in an instant," it said. The links had become "diffuse" and clearing them up "will take time," it said.
"The world of brand products is harsh. Only the segment winner, that is the market leader or at least the runner-up, succeed," Amer said.
"Wilson is the market leader in tennis and targets the same in golf, but the recapturing of lost positions is a long road," it said.

In October, citing continued difficulties in golf clubs and balls sales, Amer said Wilson would be "clearly unprofitable" in 1996. In January-October, Wilson stood for 80 percent of Amer's sport goods sales and for 60 percent of total group sales.
